title: Legislative districts of Tawi-Tawi
wikitext:
{{Short description|District in the Philippines}} {{Politics of the Philippines}} The '''legislative district of Tawi-Tawi''' is the representation of the [[Provinces of the Philippines|province]] of [[Tawi-Tawi]] in the [[List of legislatures of the Philippines|various national legislatures]] of the [[Philippines]]. The province is currently represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the [[Congress of the Philippines]] through its [[Tawi-Tawi's at-large congressional district|lone congressional district]]. == History == {{further|Legislative district of Mindanao and Sulu|Legislative district of Sulu}} Prior to gaining separate representation, areas now under the jurisdiction of Tawi-Tawi were represented under the [[Department of Mindanao and Sulu]] (1917–1935), [[Sulu]] (1935–1972) and [[Interim Batasang Pambansa#Regional Representatives|Region IX]] (1978–1984). The enactment of Presidential Decree No. 302 on September 11, 1973 created the Province of Tawi-Tawi out of Sulu's western and southern municipalities.{{cite web|title=Presidential Decree No. 302 - Creating the Province of Tawi-Tawi|url=http://www.lawphil.net/statutes/presdecs/pd1973/pd_302_1973.html|website=The LawPhil Project|first=Ferdinand E.|last=Marcos|access-date=February 6, 2017|date=September 27, 1973}} The new province was represented in the [[Interim Batasang Pambansa]] as part of [[Interim Batasang Pambansa#Regional Representatives|Region IX]] from 1978 to 1984. Tawi-Tawi first gained separate representation in [[1984 Philippine parliamentary election|1984]] when it returned [[#At-Large (defunct)|one representative, elected at large]], to the [[Regular Batasang Pambansa]]. Under the new Constitution which was proclaimed on February 11, 1987, the province constituted a [[#Lone District|lone congressional district]],{{cite web|title=1987 Constitution of the Philippines - Apportionment Ordinance|website=Official Gazette of the Republic of the Philippines |url=http://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/constitutions/the-1987-constitution-of-the-republic-of-the-philippines/the-1987-constitution-of-the-republic-of-the-philippines-ordinance/|author=1986 Constitutional Commission|date=February 2, 1987|access-date=November 28, 2017}} and elected its member to the restored [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] starting [[1987 Philippine legislative election|that same year]]. == Lone District == *'''Population (2015)''': 390,715{{cite web |url=https://psa.gov.ph/sites/default/files/attachments/hsd/pressrelease/2015_Table%201_Legislative%20Districts.xlsx|website=Philippine Statistics Authority|date=2015|title=Population of Population of Legislative Districts by Region, Province, and Selected Highly Urbanized/Component City: 2015|access-date=November 19, 2017}} {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; width:40%;" |- ! width="40%"| Period !
